# 🎵 Compose Symphony

<div align="center">

  **让 Android 交互重获生命力**
  
  <p>
    为 Jetpack Compose 带来 iOS 级别的高保真物理动画、阻尼拖拽与粒子特效。
    <br>
    <i>（本项目抽取自 <a href="https://github.com/jay3-yy/BiliPai/">bilipai</a> 客户端核心交互层）</i>
  </p>

---

**Compose Symphony** 致力于弥合 Android 与现代高端交互设计（如 iOS 风格）之间的差距。拒绝生硬的匀速运动，它开箱即用地提供了“有机”的手感、真实的物理阻尼以及令人惊叹的粒子视觉效果。

<br />

## 🗺️ 探索地图 (Navigation Map)

| **想要达成什么效果？** | **推荐组件** | **核心文件** |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **🍬 给按钮加点“果冻”感** | `bouncyClickable` | [`SpringAnimations.kt`](library/src/main/java/com/compose/symphony/animation/SpringAnimations.kt) |
| **🧲 丝滑的拖拽吸附** | `DampedDrag` | [`DampedDrag.kt`](library/src/main/java/com/compose/symphony/physics/DampedDrag.kt) |
| **⚛️ 灭霸式粒子消散** | `DissolveEffect` | [`DissolveEffect.kt`](library/src/main/java/com/compose/symphony/particle/DissolveEffect.kt) |
| **🎉 庆祝与爆炸动效** | `Celebration` | [`Celebration.kt`](library/src/main/java/com/compose/symphony/animation/Celebration.kt) |

<br />

## ✨ 核心特性 (Features)

| 特性 | 描述 | 关键优势 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **🌊 液态物理** | `physics` | 深度模拟 iOS 滚动视图的指数级阻力曲线，拖拽时手感“黏”且顺滑。 |
| **⚛️ 粒子引擎** | `particle` | 基于 OpenGL 的高性能粒子系统，可让任何 Composable 瞬间化为粉尘。 |
| **🍎 iOS 调优** | `animation` | 内置 Apple Music/App Store 同款弹簧参数 (Spring Specs)，告别猜数字调参。 |
| **🎨 微交互** | `interaction` | 提供点赞爆炸、3D 投币翻转等即插即用的微交互组件。 |

> [!TIP]
> **设计哲学**：所有的动画参数都经过精心调优，默认值即是舒适的体验（Sensible Defaults）。您只需接入，不仅“能动”，而且“好动”。

<br />

## 📦 安装 (Installation)

*(发布到 Maven Central 暂定中。目前推荐作为本地模块引入以方便二次修改)*

1. **Clone** 本仓库。
2. 在 `settings.gradle.kts` 中引入:

   ```kotlin
   include(":compose-symphony")
   project(":compose-symphony").projectDir = file("path/to/Compose-Symphony/library")
   ```

3. 在您的应用 `build.gradle.kts` 中添加依赖:

   ```kotlin
   implementation(project(":compose-symphony"))
   ```

<br />

## 🚀 快速上手 (Usage)

### 1. 极简的“果冻”按钮

只需一行代码，让按钮拥有 Apple Music 般的点击质感。

```kotlin
Box(
    modifier = Modifier
        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
        .bouncyClickable(scaleDown = 0.92f) { // 👈 Just add this!
            // Click Action 
        }
) {
    Text("Press Me")
}
```

### 2. 粒子消散容器

包裹任何内容，通过 `isDissolving` 状态触发粒子化。

```kotlin
DissolvableVideoCard(
    isDissolving = isDissolving,
    onDissolveComplete = { /* 动画结束回调 */ }
) {
    // 任何复杂的 Composable 内容...
    VideoPlayer(...)
}
```

# 🎵 Compose Symphony

Source: https://github.com/jay3-yy/compose-symphony/blob/main/README_EN.md


# 🎵 Compose Symphony

<div align="center">
  <h3>Bring the fluidity of iOS physics to Jetpack Compose.</h3>
  <br />
  <a href="README_EN.md"><img src="https://img.shields.io/badge/Language-English-blue?style=for-the-badge" /></a>
  <a href="README.md"><img src="https://img.shields.io/badge/Language-中文-red?style=for-the-badge" /></a>
  <br /><br />
  <img src="https://img.shields.io/badge/Android-Jetpack%20Compose-4285F4?style=for-the-badge&logo=android&logoColor=white" />
  <img src="https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-green?style=for-the-badge" />
  <img src="https://img.shields.io/badge/Kotlin-100%25-7F52FF?style=for-the-badge&logo=kotlin&logoColor=white" />
</div>

<br />

**Compose Symphony** is a collection of high-fidelity, physics-based animation components designed to bridge the gap between Android and modern iOS-style interactions. It provides "organic" feel, damped drags, and stunning particle effects out of the box.

## 🗺️ Where to Start

If you are new to this library, we recommend starting here:

1. **Want bouncy buttons?**
    * Check out **[`SpringAnimations.kt`](library/src/main/java/com/compose/symphony/animation/SpringAnimations.kt)**.
    * Try `modifier.bouncyClickable()` or `iOSSpringSpecs.ButtonPress`.

2. **Looking for fluid dragging?**
    * Look at **[`DampedDrag.kt`](library/src/main/java/com/compose/symphony/physics/DampedDrag.kt)**.
    * The core class is `DampedDragAnimationState`.

3. **Need particle effects?**
    * Go to **[`DissolveEffect.kt`](library/src/main/java/com/compose/symphony/particle/DissolveEffect.kt)**.
    * This contains the high-perf OpenGL implementation for the "Thanos Snap".

## ✨ Features

### 🌊 Liquid Physics (`com.compose.symphony.physics`)

True "rubbed-band" resistance that feels alive.

* **`DampedDragAnimationState`**: Production-ready state management for dragging.
* **Exponential Resistance**: Mimics the exact resistance curve of iOS scroll views.
* **Velocity Snapping**: Flicks naturally carry momentum.

### ⚛️ Particle Effects (`com.compose.symphony.particle`)

Cinema-grade visual effects using OpenGL.

* **`ParticleDissolveEffect`**: The "Thanos Snap" disintegration effect.
* **High Performance**: Renders thousands of particles at 60fps using `GLSurfaceView` overlay.
* **Seamless Integration**: Captures any Composable content automatically.

### 🍎 iOS Spring Presets (`com.compose.symphony.animation`)

Don't guess magic numbers. Use tuned constants.

* `iOSSpringSpecs.ButtonPress`: The specific tightness used in Apple Music buttons.
* `iOSSpringSpecs.CardExpand`: The exact spring curve for App Store card expansions.
* `bouncyClickable`: A modifier to instantly add "juice" to any component.

### 🎉 Micro-Interactions

* **`LikeBurstAnimation`**: Instagram-style heart explosion.
* **`CoinSuccessAnimation`**: Satisfying 3D-like spinning coin reward.
* **`Celebrate.kt`**: Pure Compose implementations—no heavy Lottie libraries required.

## 📦 Installation

*(Publishing to Maven Central is pending. For now, include as a local module)*

1. Clone this repository.
2. In `settings.gradle.kts`:

   ```kotlin
   include(":compose-symphony")
   project(":compose-symphony").projectDir = file("path/to/Compose-Symphony/library")
   ```

3. In your app `build.gradle.kts`:

   ```kotlin
   implementation(project(":compose-symphony"))
   ```

## 🚀 Usage

### 1. The "Liquid" Drag

Create a tab bar or card list that feels magnetic.

```kotlin
val dragState = rememberDampedDragAnimationState(
    initialIndex = 0,
    itemCount = 3,
    onIndexChanged = { /* Handle Selection */ }
)

Box(
    modifier = Modifier
        .horizontalDragGesture(dragState, widthPx)
        .graphicsLayer { 
             translationX = -dragState.value * widthPx 
        }
) {
    // Content
}
```

### 2. The "Desintegrate" Effect

Wrap any content to make it dissolvable.

```kotlin
var isDissolving by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }

DissolvableVideoCard(
    isDissolving = isDissolving,
    onDissolveComplete = { 
        // Remove data from list
    }
) {
    VideoCardContent()
}
```

### 3. Instant "Juice"

Make any button feel premium.

```kotlin
Box(
    modifier = Modifier
        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
        .bouncyClickable(scaleDown = 0.92f) { 
            // Click Action 
        }
) {
    Text("Press Me")
}
```
